_doc: NVIDIA Build/NIM capability matrix. Method: LIVE single-shot probes on our own API key (not model-card theory) with per-model timeout. RE-VALIDATED 2026-07-17 (10 days after the 2026-07-07 baseline) — the endpoint drifted HARD: 4 of 6 role-models broke. kimi-k2.6 -> HTTP 404 (gone), mistral-large-3-675b -> HANGS >22s, gpt-oss-120b -> EMPTY content via our text adapter, llama-4-maverick -> HANGS >22s. Only minimax-m3 (default) and nemotron-3-nano (fast) survived. Replacements were found by probing the live 119-model catalog with a real coding prompt: nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b (coding), deepseek-v4-flash (reasoning; it ERRORED on 07-07 but RECOVERED), mistral-small-4-119b-2603 (review). deepseek-v4-PRO still HANGS — only FLASH is safe. NVIDIA is called SINGLE-SHOT as a tool (not the agent runtime), so raw quality + a non-hanging clean response is what counts. Lead/Boss ALWAYS runs on Claude Opus 4.8. RE-PROBE before trusting after ~1 week: models come and go on this endpoint. RE-VALIDATED AGAIN 2026-07-25 (8 days after 07-17) — good news: all 6 distinct role-models (default/fast=coding-fast/reasoning/review/coding/vision) responded correctly on a live minimal chat call, 0 broken this round. Notably llama-4-maverick (vision) RECOVERED from its 07-17 HANG (>22s) -> now WORKING (340ms, clean). vision stays tier=avoid regardless because the adapter is still TEXT-ONLY (no image-block support) — real screenshot/vision analysis still runs on Claude UI Boss, not NVIDIA. No fallback probes were needed (nothing was broken). RE-PROBE before trusting after ~1 week: this endpoint flip-flops both ways (07-07 OK -> 07-17 broken -> 07-25 OK again, for vision).

default.why: REMAPPED 2026-07-26 (WP-NVIDIA-CONSOLIDATE, owner directive to consolidate to the fewest genuinely-best models). Cross-probe evidence (function-model-fit.json 'summarize' function, same real ~280-word content): nemotron-3-nano, once given adequate token headroom (900 vs an initial too-tight 400), answered correctly in 3449ms — ~16.7x faster than minimax's 57424ms on an equal-shape real-content task, and its own cheap 'PIPELINE OK' ping is ~0.6s vs minimax's ~5.9s. No function or bulk-allowed Boss primary path needed minimax-m3 anymore after the consolidation round (see function-model-fit.json consolidation.droppedFromFunctionFit) — general in-task drafting/summaries/classification now routes to nano by default.

premiumFallback.when: Lead/Boss ALWAYS Opus 4.8. High-risk reasoning, architecture, deep code review, final QA, security, complex planning, AND all real vision/screenshot analysis (adapter is text-only) -> Claude. Sonnet 5 is the price/performance fallback; Opus 4.8 is accuracy-first. NVIDIA reduces cost on bulk in-task work; it never replaces a premium assignment and never handles the final verdict.

honesty: Every ROLE model (default/fast/coding-fast/reasoning/review/coding/vision) was re-probed live again on 2026-07-25 (8 days after 07-17) — this time all 6 distinct role-models responded correctly (0 broken), including vision recovering from its 07-17 hang. Catalog entries NOT in an active role (mistral-nemotron, thinkingmachines/inkling, nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning, mistral-medium-3.5-128b, deepseek-v4-pro) were left at their 07-17 probe date — they were out of scope for this run and are correspondingly stale by this file's own ~1-week rule. The 2026-07-07 matrix was 4/6 stale within 10 days — model cards and benchmarks did NOT predict which models hang, 404, or return empty on this endpoint; flakiness runs both ways (a model can recover too, as vision did here). Re-probe with a real chat call (see .claude/forge-bin/nvidia-provider.cjs) after ~1 week before trusting any entry. CONSOLIDATION ROUND (2026-07-26, WP-NVIDIA-CONSOLIDATE, owner directive to keep only the fewest genuinely-best-in-class models): 10 live cross-probes compared nemotron-3-nano/nemotron-3-super/deepseek-v4-flash head-to-head on the SAME real mini-tasks (summarize, translate-rewrite, code-draft edge-case, research-digest, data-extract) — full evidence lives in function-model-fit.json (functions.*.alts + the new `consolidation` block), not duplicated here. Net effect on THIS file: only the `default` ROLE model changed (minimax-m3 -> nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b, evidence in roles.default.why); the `reasoning`/`review`/`coding`/`fast`/`coding-fast`/`vision` ROLE bindings are UNCHANGED — this round only reassigned which model backs each FUNCTION in function-model-fit.json, plus this one ROLE remap that was explicitly in scope. minimax-m3 and mistral-small-4-119b-2603 remain in the catalog (not deleted) as historical/reference entries since neither is provably broken, just no longer the best-in-class pick for anything currently routed.
